name: The host
definition: The machine and the operating system on which the platform runs, and what the owner of the host runs on it for the platform (DEC-177). Each part reads the instant from it, so the instant crosses no interface.

name: The user
definition: The user and each client with which the user reaches the platform.

name: An external service
definition: A service outside the host that the platform reaches through External Access, a model provider included (DEC-161).
